name: Lantern Cove Gatehouse — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Twin pearl-stone gateway towers with gold domes, pointed blue/gold window screens, a high open central arch, lanterns/garlands and broad front steps. Tiny iso suggests a repeated gateway group; the central sea view is a key feature. Hidden layout inference: Connect a sheltered cove landing to the gate apron, then pass under the arch toward the principal bridge. Side tower balconies become small lookout pockets rather than closing the harbor vista. Place compact planted strips, lamps and route signs outside the through lane. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B19-STRUCT-001 — Lantern Cove Gatehouse — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need tower/arch springing modules, gate-to-quay/bridge threshold and dome seats. Existing open screens, gold roof and harbor lamp language reused; mirrored tower count/hidden third group requires parity review. Coastal shrubs/grass, seabirds/moths and fish below quay proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
